## User Flows Identified

### Flow 1: Standard Login
1. Enter username
2. Enter password
3. Click Login
4. Redirect to /inventory.html

### Flow 2: Failed Login (invalid credentials)
1. Enter invalid username/password
2. Click Login
3. Error message appears

### Flow 3: Empty Submission
1. Click Login without entering credentials
2. Validation error appears
